paper_title: Short-range spin-dependent interactions of electrons: a probe for exotic pseudo-Goldstone bosons
notes: Torsion pendulum measuring electron spin-dependent dipole-dipole interaction from pseudoscalar exchange. The paper's primary Vdd result is a constraint on (g_p^e)^2/(hbar c) < 5.5e-17 for m_b < 30 ueV, valid up to m_b <= 500 ueV. This is the SQUARE of the pseudoscalar electron coupling, NOT the dimensionless g_ae directly - downstream conversion needed (sqrt gives g_p^e ~ 7.4e-9, and relation to g_ae involves factors). Emitted value is the raw (g_p^e)^2/(hbar c) as quoted. Horizontal line spanning mass validity range. Paper also reports monopole-dipole (MonopoleDipole) limits |g_p^e g_s^N|/hbar c at 10^-28 level for 1.5-400 ueV - a separate result not encoded here. Confidence lowered due to coupling being squared and mixed monopole/dipole content. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.5, 22)) | Vision: Bottom panel of Fig.4 plots g_p^2/(hbar c) (squared coupling) vs m_b in micro-eV; the 'this work' lower boundary is a plateau near 8e-17 to 1e-16 up to ~100 ueV then rises steeply near 500 ueV. Coupling is electron pseudoscalar squared, NOT canonical g_ae. Values emitted are the plotted squared quantity per plotted-values contract.
